summary.zh: 五个视角围攻想法，给出推进、改造或放弃的结论
summary.en: Five-angle panel attacks an idea, judge gives a verdict

description.zh: 让批评者、拥护者、分析师、调查者和客户五个角色分别攻击一个想法，再由裁判给出推进、改造或放弃的结论，并附上成本最低的验证测试。适合动手做产品之前做一轮严格的压力测试，不需要额外配置。
description.en: Five roles (Critic, Champion, Analyst, Investigator, Customer) attack an idea, then a judge returns GO, RESHAPE or KILL plus the cheapest test to de-risk it. Good for pressure-testing before you build.
